answer: Physical courier attestation: each identity must periodically receive a tamper-evident token physically delivered to a registered address, then present it within a fixed horizon to stay active. A single operator cannot fake delivery across many addresses without real couriers and real travel time, so each identity costs a separate physical voyage of staff and transit. A legitimate operator can build a haven of verified addresses, but scaling requires hiring couriers proportional to identities, making mass sybils economically and logistically costly.
